# scylladbcloud_availability_zones (Data Source)

The availability zone IDs clusters can use in a region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_availability_zones" "example" {
	region = "us-east-1"
}

output "zone_ids" {
	value = data.scylladbcloud_availability_zones.example.zone_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Cloud region, e.g. us-east-1.

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider, AWS or GCP.
- `cloud_account_id` (Number) Cloud account to list zones for; defaults to ScyllaDB's account for the cloud.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `zone_ids` (List of String) Availability zone IDs, e.g. use1-az1.
